one_minute_value_explanation: AOF can now bundle provider readiness evidence into one production go/no-go candidate for operator judgment without authorizing live execution.
thirty_second_version_delta: Before v9.8, the provider readiness chain existed as separate artifacts. After v9.8, the chain is presented as one bounded production go/no-go evidence candidate with explicit not-proven boundaries.
product_review_trigger: If an operator cannot distinguish a go/no-go evidence candidate from production execution permission, reopen product value comprehension and safety wording before release.
not_proven: Does not prove live provider execution safety, credential or billing safety, provider semantic correctness, actual rollback execution success, customer impact absence, third-party acceptance, or market value.
